recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-13636 unless a future work group decision asks for a new icon redesign rather than reconciliation of the published STU3 color change.
issue_request: FHIR-13636 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request asking that the similar yellow Resource, Element, Data Type, and Primitive Data Type logical-table icons be made easier to distinguish by darkening the icon lines.
initial_application: The request was applied by svn revision 14598, represented in Git as 26b87b075e1b3a536e672ca38ac633d56831eeec, with the commit subject "GF#13132 + GF#13636 - minor chanages to colors". That commit changed icon_resource.png, icon_element.gif, icon_datatype.gif, and icon_primitive.png among other color-related files.
additional_context: The affected icon assets were moved from images/ to tools/html/ by 859e00e79855a8484e57bcf160fa3fc434968b59 as 100% renames. Current source/formats.html still references the Resource, Element, Primitive Datatype, and Datatype icons in the logical-table example and type-icon key. FHIR-13132 shared the original application commit for a separate color/background issue and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current tools/html icon files are byte-identical to the corresponding post-application blobs from the 2018 GF#13636 commit, so the current source already preserves the applied darker icon assets.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-13132 was applied in the same 2018 color-change commit but concerns separate publish-box/background colors and is already represented on the combined branch.
